subject: Cadae AI
tagline: A virtual chief engineer for hotels: AI that finds energy and water savings and prepares the work, while the hotel team approves.

sources.title: Cadae: a virtual chief engineer for every hotel
A virtual chief engineer for hotel energy and water (5 November 2026)
Cadae AI at Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (ALPHA)

what_it_does.text: Cadae (Cadae Limited, London) models what each hotel should use in energy and water, measures the gap every month, finds and costs savings projects, tracks delivery and verifies savings against a baseline. Its AI prepares investigations and proposed actions for the hotel team to review and approve. Since 15 August 2026 an MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor query a hotel portfolio, scoped to the user's access.

agents.name: Cadae's AI (the virtual chief engineer)
agents.what: Prepares investigations and proposed actions on energy and water.
actions: Combines utility use with hotel activity and weather
Prepares an investigation or a proposed action with evidence and costs
Tracks delivery and checks outcomes against a baseline

agents.name: Cadae MCP server
agents.what: Connects AI assistants to hotels, results, projects, savings tasks and people.
actions: Exposes portfolio data to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
Scoped to the access the user already holds (OAuth or API token)

use_cases.name: An owner asks an AI assistant which hotel to fix first
use_cases.who: Hotel groups and owners using Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through the MCP server

reach.what: Hotels, PHI results, projects, savings tasks and people in the portfolio
Whatever the user's own permissions allow

mandate.what: Illustrative: read results and projects to answer questions; no changes.
Illustrative: any new project or approval goes through a person in Cadae.

gap.what: The MCP page does not say whether its tools can write (create projects, approve tasks), only that access follows the user's permissions.

controls.what: "Cadae does not commit budget, contact contractors or change how plant runs."
"Cadae's AI prepares the next steps for your team to review and approve."
MCP access is "scoped to the access you hold"

questions: Can the MCP tools create or approve anything, or only read?
When an AI assistant reads a portfolio through MCP, is each read recorded for the owner?
Who in the hotel approves a proposed action, and is that approval recorded with the verified savings?
